method: Six 30-second excerpts, each taken from the beginning of its source and matched to -23 LUFS. All MIDI samples use the same Salamander piano; the direct-audio baseline supplies its own timbre. Identical 20 ms edge fades; no frequency filtering, denoising or compression.
coverageNote: Two local MIDI models were generated with two predetermined seeds each. The set also includes one existing direct-audio baseline and one authored MIDI reference. The unavailable routes below have no listening sample.

coverage.name: Aria
coverage.detail: Two piano continuations from one original eight-bar MIDI prompt. The prompt is excluded from both listening excerpts.

coverage.name: Text2midi
coverage.detail: Both outputs ignored the solo-piano instrumentation request. Listening versions omit percussion and play all remaining notes on piano. Raw MIDI is preserved; the reveal identifies the adaptations.

coverage.name: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo
coverage.detail: One existing direct-audio piano attempt. No new ACE-Step generation was run for this set.

coverage.name: Authored MIDI reference
coverage.detail: An original eight-bar phrase written in code, rendered on the common piano. This is a reference, not output from a trained music-generation model.

coverage.name: Salamander Grand Piano V3
coverage.detail: The same real piano sample library renders all MIDI-derived excerpts.

coverage.name: Eleven Music v2.5
coverage.detail: No account or API credentials are available.

coverage.name: Lyria 3.5
coverage.detail: No account or API credentials are available.

coverage.name: Stable Audio 3
coverage.detail: Official Medium and Small Music weights require gated Hugging Face access. Unauthenticated downloads returned 401; no authorized credentials are available.

coverage.name: Pianoteq
coverage.detail: No installed licensed copy is available. Its restricted trial is not used in this comparison.

Rendered with sfizz 1.2.3; mechanical key/pedal noise layers omitted. Listening excerpts cropped, edge-faded and gain-matched.
